FOR NEW ZEALAND GUIDES

Put your guiding business in front of more travellers.

Kiwi Guides connects tourists and outdoor travellers with guides throughout New Zealand. Whether you offer fly fishing, hunting, back country adventures, helicopter accessed trips, day tours or multi day experiences, Kiwi Guides gives customers one place to discover and book local guides.

WHY USE KIWI GUIDES?

Connect with tourists looking for local guides.

Your profile can showcase your experience, social media, areas you guide and more than one listing.

Reach travellers

Be found by tourists actively looking for guided New Zealand experiences.

Multiple listings

Add separate day trips, multi day trips, back country experiences and different locations.

Build your profile

Add photos, bio, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and your own website.

9% + GSTone off fee per booking

No added Kiwi Guides fees.

Kiwi Guides charges one booking fee of 9% + GST. There are no extra Kiwi Guides listing or platform fees added on top.

Application review: New guide applications are reviewed before the guide profile or listings are made live.
Secure database connected

New guide application

Submitting creates your guide login and sends your application for review. Your profile will not appear publicly until Kiwi Guides approves it.

What happens next?

Application submitted → Kiwi Guides reviews your details → approved guide account activated → add profile, social links and multiple listings → new listings can be reviewed before going live.
